components.name: Badge
components.description: Figma Badge (260:4825): Size × Theme × Background, a leading dot or icon, and an optional remove button.

props.name: size
props.description: Short (sm, md…) or Figma (small, medium…) spelling.

props.name: leading
props.description: Leading icon: an icon name (`"icon-check-line"`) or a node; replaces the default dot.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Figma Leading-Icon: shows the leading layer (the default dot, or `leading`); false hides it, `leading` included.

props.name: remove
props.description: Shows the remove button (icon-x-circle-solid), named "Remove <label>" from a text label (the locale's `removeItem`).

props.name: removeLabel
props.description:
Name of the remove button. Default: "Remove" and the badge text from the locale's labels ("Remove Design"); pass it
when the label is not plain text (a node, an icon, a number) so the button still says what it removes.

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides: props of the icon the badge draws, by layer (`{ Leading: { name: "icon-check-line" } }`).
 Written by Zen Studio; app code sets `leading`.

components.name: BadgeStatus
components.description:
Figma Badge-Status (16932:195, page ❖ Badge): Status × Size, promoted from the HR-Platform template. A task's or a
project's workflow step as a Subtle badge whose ring fills as the work moves on. Built on the Badge tokens
(Badge/Size, Badge/Spacing; the ring Element-Size/Popular/Base on Medium, Popular/Small on Small, left padding
Spacing/Padding/2XSmall · 3XSmall so the ring is concentric with the pill). Colours per step:
Color/Background/<Tone>/Subtle/Default, the label Content/<Tone>/Strongest, the ring Content/<Tone>/Light. Blocked and
Cancelled use the library's icon-slash-circle-01-line and icon-x-circle-line. The ring is
.Primitives/Badge/Progress-Icon (16943:171).

props.name: status
props.description: The workflow step: to-do (Neutral) · in-progress (Info) · in-review (Warning) · done (Positive) · blocked (Negative) · cancelled (Neutral, muted label).

props.name: size
props.description: Short (sm, md) or Figma (small, medium) spelling. Medium is 28 high with a 20px ring, Small 20 with a 16px ring.

props.name: progress
props.description:
How full the ring is, 0–100 (Figma: the Progress layer's arc). Default: the step's own value (to-do 0, in-progress 25,
in-review 50, done 100). Set it for an exact value (a project at 60%); it is then read after the label. Blocked and
Cancelled have no ring and ignore it.

props.name: children
props.description: The label. Default: the step's name from the locale's labels (en "In Progress", vi "Đang làm").
